title: PENGARUH MEDIA PEMBELAJARAN INTERAKTIV CANVA TERHADAP MINAT DAN KREATIVITAS BELAJAR SISWA KELAS XI SMAK SANTO FRANSISKUS ASISI LARANTUKA
abstractText: This study aims to examine differences in students' learning interest and learning creativity before and after the implementation of Canva-based interactive learning media among eleventh-grade students at SMAK Santo Fransiskus Asisi Larantuka. A quantitative approach with a pre-experimental design (one-group pretest–posttest design) was utilized, involving 27 students as the research sample selected through total sampling technique. Data were gathered using Likert-scale questionnaires measuring learning interest and creativity, complemented by classroom observation sheets, and subsequently analyzed using paired sample t-tests and effect size calculations (Cohen’s d). The statistical results demonstrated a significant increase in students' learning interest from a pretest mean of 26.44 to a posttest mean of 42.52 with an average gain of 16.07 (t=18.59; df=26; p<0.001; d=3.58). A significant increase was likewise identified in students' learning creativity, rising from a pretest mean of 25.00 to a posttest mean of 43.11 with an average gain of 18.11 (t=23.34; df=26; p<0.001; d=4.49). The remarkably large effect sizes indicate that the integration of Canva interactive visual media substantially enhances learning engagement and facilitates the articulation of creative ideas in secondary school classrooms. ABSTRAK Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengkaji perbedaan minat dan kreativitas belajar siswa sebelum dan sesudah penerapan media pembelajaran interaktif berbasis Canva pada siswa kelas XI SMAK Santo Fransiskus Asisi Larantuka. Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif dengan desain pra-eksperimen (one-group pretest–posttest design) yang melibatkan 27 siswa sebagai sampel penelitian melalui teknik total sampling. Pengumpulan data dilakukan menggunakan kuesioner skala Likert untuk mengukur minat dan kreativitas belajar yang dilengkapi dengan lembar observasi aktivitas belajar, kemudian dianalisis menggunakan uji beda berpasangan (paired sample t-test) serta perhitungan ukuran efek (effect size Cohen’s d). Hasil analisis menunjukkan adanya peningkatan yang signifikan pada minat belajar siswa dari rata-rata skor pretest sebesar 26,44 menjadi 42,52 pada posttest dengan selisih rata-rata 16,07 (t=18,59; df=26; p<0,001; d=3,58). Peningkatan yang signifikan juga terjadi pada kreativitas belajar siswa dari rata-rata skor pretest sebesar 25,00 menjadi 43,11 pada posttest dengan selisih rata-rata 18,11 (t=23,34; df=26; p<0,001; d=4,49). Nilai Cohen’s d yang berada pada kategori efek sangat besar mengindikasikan bahwa integrasi media visual interaktif Canva berkontribusi nyata dalam menumbuhkan ketertarikan belajar sekaligus memfasilitasi ekspresi gagasan kreatif siswa di kelas.

Lactate trajectory patterns in neonatal necrotizing enterocolitis: an exploratory retrospective cohort study using group-based trajectory modeling
abstractText: Abstract Background Necrotizing enterocolitis (NEC) is a devastating neonatal condition with high mortality, yet early identification of infants at highest risk remains challenging. Lactate dynamics may offer prognostic value beyond single measurements, yet statistical trajectory patterns in NEC remain unexplored, particularly in real-world settings with substantial data missingness. Methods This retrospective cohort study included 106 neonates with NEC from the Pediatric Intensive Care Database, grouped into three categories: non-surgical ( n = 63), early surgery (≤ 3 days, n = 18), and late surgery (> 3 days, n = 25). Group-based trajectory modeling (GBTM) was applied within each stratum to identify lactate trajectory patterns (posterior probability > 0.7). Postoperative lactate measurements within 24 h were excluded. Bootstrap resampling (300 replicates) assessed parameter stability in the non-surgical group. Results GBTM identified trajectory patterns linked to management decisions. A high-and-rising trajectory pattern (initial lactate 11.39 mmol/L, increase 4.93 mmol/L/day) occurred in 2 non-surgical neonates (3.2%) and was associated with 100% mortality within 48 h. All 43 surgical patients survived, exhibiting stable or clearing trajectories. Bootstrap analysis confirmed model stability in the non-surgical group, with a coefficient of variation < 30% for all. Conclusion This exploratory study identified a steeply rising lactate trajectory associated with early mortality in NEC, suggesting that dynamic lactate trends may complement static markers for risk assessment, pending prospective validation. Trial registration Clinical trial number: not applicable.

Prophylactic administration of probiotic strains Weizmannia coagulans and Saccharomyces boulardii attenuates early dysplastic changes in an AOM/DSS-induced mouse model
abstractText: Abstract Background Colorectal dysplasia represents an early stage of colorectal carcinogenesis and is closely associated with chronic inflammation and altered microRNA (miRNA) expression. Probiotic strains such as Weizmannia coagulans (formerly Bacillus coagulans) and Saccharomyces boulardii possess anti-inflammatory properties and may influence host miRNA expression, suggesting their potential as prophylactic agents against inflammation-associated colorectal dysplasia. Methods Mice received prophylactic oral administration of Weizmannia coagulans or Saccharomyces boulardii beginning one week before azoxymethane/dextran sulfate sodium (AOM/DSS) induction and continuing throughout the experimental period. Histopathological examination, TNF-α immunohistochemistry, serum pro-inflammatory cytokine measurements, and miRNA expression profiling using reverse transcription quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR) were performed to evaluate the prophylactic effects of both probiotic strains. Results Prophylactic administration of both probiotic strains significantly attenuated early dysplastic alterations and inflammatory cell infiltration compared with the AOM/DSS group ( p < 0.05). These histopathological improvements were accompanied by significantly lower serum levels of the pro-inflammatory cytokines IL-6 and IL-1β, together with reduced TNF-α immunoreactivity ( p < 0.05). In addition, probiotic pretreatment attenuated the altered miRNA expression profile induced by AOM/DSS. Compared with the model group, expression of miR-122-5p, miR-29b-5p, and miR-15b-5p was significantly reduced, whereas miR-98-5p, miR-202-5p, miR-21-5p, and let-7i-5p showed increased expression and were associated with miRNA expression patterns that more closely resembled those of the control group ( p < 0.01). Conclusion Prophylactic administration of Weizmannia coagulans and Saccharomyces boulardii reduced inflammation-associated early dysplastic changes while preserving normal miRNA expression patterns in an AOM/DSS-induced murine model. These findings support the potential of probiotic prophylaxis as an early preventive strategy against colorectal dysplasia and provide a foundation for future studies investigating its clinical applicability.

title: Optimalisasi Pembelajaran Menyenangkan dan Bermakna bagi Siswa Sekolah Dasar melalui Media Game Edukatif Educaplay di SB Kampung Baru, Kuala Lumpur
abstractText: Kegiatan Pengabdian kepada Masyarakat (PkM) ini bertujuan mengoptimalkan pembelajaran yang menyenangkan dan bermakna bagi siswa sekolah dasar melalui pemanfaatan media game edukatif Educaplay di Sanggar Bimbingan Kampung Baru, Kuala Lumpur. Metode pelaksanaan menggunakan pendekatan partisipatif dan pendampingan yang melibatkan pengelola, pendidik, relawan, tim pengabdi, dan siswa. Kegiatan dilaksanakan melalui lima tahapan, yaitu sosialisasi, pelatihan, penerapan teknologi, pendampingan dan evaluasi, serta keberlanjutan program. Evaluasi dilakukan melalui observasi, pre-test, post-test, dan angket respons peserta. Hasil kegiatan menunjukkan adanya peningkatan keterlibatan siswa pada aspek keaktifan, antusiasme, fokus, kerja sama, dan kemampuan menggunakan teknologi. Rata-rata nilai siswa meningkat dari 55,71 pada pre-test menjadi 91,86 pada post-test, dengan nilai N-Gain sebesar 0,82 yang termasuk kategori tinggi. title: COMPARAÇÃO ENTRE ESTRATÉGIAS EDUCATIVAS NA COMPREENSÃO DA ATEROSCLEROSE E PERCEPÇÃO DE RISCO CARDIOVASCULAR UMA REVISÃO INTEGRATIVA
abstractText: Cardiovascular diseases represent the leading cause of mortality worldwide and are strongly associated with atherosclerosis. This study aimed to compare the effectiveness of different educational strategies in improving understanding of atherosclerosis and the perception of cardiovascular risk. This is an integrative literature review conducted through searches in the Scientific Electronic Library Online (SciELO), PubMed/MEDLINE, and Google Scholar databases. The descriptors “atherosclerosis,” “health education,” and “cardiovascular risk” were used in combination with the Boolean operators AND and OR. The inclusion criteria comprised articles published between 2014 and 2025, available in full text, in Portuguese, English, or Spanish. After applying the eligibility criteria, 10 studies comprised the final sample. The results showed that educational videos are more effective in improving understanding of the pathophysiological mechanisms of atherosclerosis, whereas cardiovascular risk calculators have a greater impact on the perception of individual risk. In addition, combined strategies demonstrated better outcomes by promoting both knowledge and motivation for behavioral changes. It is concluded that the combination of different educational approaches enhances health education initiatives, contributing to the prevention of cardiovascular diseases and strengthening self-care.

Molecular Connectivity Controls Electronic Coupling and Charge-Transfer Dynamics at Anthracene–MoS2 Interfaces
abstractText: Abstract Controlling interfacial charge-transfer (CT) interactions is a central challenge in two-dimensional (2D) organic–inorganic hybrid materials. Here, we show that molecular connectivity strongly governs excited-state evolution at a 2D heterointerface using anthracene (An) donors covalently attached to few-layer MoS2 nanosheets through an N-benzylsuccinimide linker at either the 2- or 9-position, generating two constitutional isomers, MoS2-2-An and MoS2-9-An. Ultrafast transient absorption spectroscopy reveals markedly different photodynamics that depend strongly on the donor attachment position. Photoexcitation of MoS2-2-An produces a long-lived interfacial CT excited state, whereas MoS2-9-An undergoes rapid formation of a full charge-separated state. The contrasting behavior is consistent with connectivity-controlled differences in donor orientation at the interface, which modulate orbital overlap and electronic coupling and may influence structural reorganization. Theoretical calculations further support that the more coplanar geometry of 2-An, exhibiting a calculated tilt angle (θ) of 29.5° relative to the MoS2 basal plane, enhances electronic coupling and stabilizes an intermediately coupled CT state, whereas the more upright 9-An orientation (θ = 42.1°) weakens orbital mixing and favors direct charge separation. These findings demonstrate that constitutional connectivity can serve as a molecular-level design parameter for tuning interfacial electronic coupling and directing excited-state evolution in 2D hybrid heterostructures relevant to optoelectronics, photocatalysis, and solar-energy conversion.

title: Factors associated with U15-to-U17 roster reappearance in Chinese female youth basketball players: a retrospective longitudinal cohort study
abstractText: Abstract Background Relative age effects (RAE) are well documented in youth basketball, but whether age-related patterns at U15 are associated with later roster reappearance in multi-birth-year competitions remains unclear. This study examined factors associated with U17 roster reappearance among Chinese female youth basketball players, with particular attention to within-year relative age and birth year. Methods This retrospective longitudinal cohort included 439 players from 37 teams in the 2023 National U15 Women’s Basketball Championship, matched against the publicly available 2025 U17 roster. Roster reappearance was defined as presence on that roster. Birth-quarter distribution was assessed against equal-quarter and population-based sensitivity references. Sequentially adjusted logistic regression included continuous relative age, birth year, anthropometric characteristics, playing position, minutes per appearance, and mGmSc/min. Team-cluster-robust and other sensitivity analyses were performed. Results Eighty-five players reappeared at U17 (19.4%, 95% CI 15.9–23.3%). The U15 birth-quarter distribution was non-uniform (χ²(3) = 19.943, p < 0.001, Cohen’s w = 0.213), with a similar result using the population-based reference (χ²(3) = 19.395, p < 0.001). In the fully adjusted model ( n = 435), continuous relative age was not clearly associated with roster reappearance (OR = 1.040 per 30 days later, 95% CI 0.973–1.112, p = 0.244), and birth year showed no clear overall association ( p = 0.773). Greater height was associated with higher odds of roster reappearance (OR = 1.080 per 1 cm, 95% CI 1.027–1.136, p = 0.003), as were greater minutes per appearance (OR = 1.264 per 5 min, 95% CI 1.030–1.552, p = 0.025). The latter association was attenuated after additional adjustment for games played (OR = 1.217, 95% CI 0.981–1.509, p = 0.074). No clear adjusted association was observed for mGmSc/min. Model performance was modest (Nagelkerke R²=0.094; AUC = 0.684). Conclusions The U15 cohort showed a birth-quarter distribution consistent with an RAE in roster representation, but neither within-year relative age nor birth year showed a clear association with subsequent U17 roster reappearance. Height showed the most consistent positive association, whereas the association with competition exposure was less robust after accounting for games played. These findings concern U17 roster reappearance in national competition records and do not establish ongoing membership within the same talent-development pathway.

title: Visible-Light-Induced Synthesis for Sulfonyl (Thio)chromones and 4-Quinolones from 2-Alknyl Benzaldehydes and Sodium Sulfinates via a Cascade Sulfonylation/Cyclization/Isomerization Processes
abstractText: Abstract Herein, we report a visible-light-mediated photoredox reaction for the synthesis of sulfonyl 4-(thio)chromones and 4-quinolone derivatives. This transformation employs easily accessible 2-alkynyl benzaldehydes and sodium sulfinates as starting materials, enabling a one-pot cascade process involving radical sulfonylation, cyclization, and isomerization under mild conditions. Notably, this strategy allows the straightforward assembly of protecting-group-free sulfonyl 4-quinolones. Benefiting from its operational simplicity, broad substrate scope, and excellent functional group compatibility, this protocol provides a practical approach for the construction of valuable 4-(thio)chromones and 4-quinolone derivatives with potential biological and synthetic applications

title: EFEKTIVITAS MEDIA SOSIAL TERHADAP PENINGKATAN PENGETAHUAN TENTANG ANEMIA PADA REMAJA PUTRI
abstractText: Anemia remains a major public health concern among adolescent girls, negatively affecting physical fitness, cognitive function, academic performance, and long-term productivity. The high adoption rate of digital platforms among the younger generation provides a strategic opportunity for leveraging social media as a health education tool. This study aimed to analyze the comparative effectiveness of Instagram, TikTok, and WhatsApp in enhancing knowledge regarding anemia among adolescent girls at the Department of Midwifery, Poltekkes Kemenkes Tanjungkarang. A quasi-experimental three-group pretest-posttest design was utilized, involving 123 first-year female students allocated into an Instagram group (38 respondents), a TikTok group (53 respondents), and a WhatsApp group (32 respondents) via purposive sampling. Data were collected using structured questionnaires measuring cognitive levels of knowing, comprehending, and applying, and were subsequently analyzed using the Wilcoxon signed-rank test and Kruskal-Wallis test. The results demonstrated that all three social media platforms significantly improved anemia knowledge across all measured dimensions post-intervention (p<0.01). The Kruskal-Wallis test confirmed a statistically significant difference in effectiveness among the three platforms (χ^2=11.005; df=2; p=0.004). The TikTok group achieved the highest mean rank (73.84), followed by the WhatsApp group (55.80) and the Instagram group (50.71). Consequently, short-video-based platforms such as TikTok exhibit the greatest pedagogical utility and are strongly recommended as the primary medium for targeted public health interventions against adolescent anemia. ABSTRAK Anemia masih menjadi permasalahan kesehatan masyarakat yang signifikan pada remaja putri karena berdampak buruk terhadap kesehatan fisik, kapasitas kognitif, prestasi akademik, dan produktivitas jangka panjang. Tingginya adopsi platform digital di kalangan generasi muda membuka peluang strategis untuk pemanfaatannya sebagai media promosi dan intervensi edukasi kesehatan. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis efektivitas media sosial Instagram, TikTok, dan WhatsApp terhadap peningkatan pengetahuan tentang anemia pada remaja putri di Jurusan Kebidanan Poltekkes Kemenkes Tanjungkarang. Desain penelitian menggunakan kuasi-eksperimen rancangan three-group pretest-posttest design dengan jumlah sampel sebanyak 123 mahasiswi tingkat I yang terbagi ke dalam kelompok Instagram (38 responden), TikTok (53 responden), dan WhatsApp (32 responden) melalui teknik purposive sampling. Data dikumpulkan menggunakan kuesioner terstruktur yang mengukur tingkatan kognitif mengetahui, memahami, dan menerapkan, lalu dianalisis menggunakan uji Wilcoxon signed-rank test dan uji komparatif Kruskal-Wallis. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa ketiga media sosial terbukti meningkatkan pengetahuan tentang anemia secara signifikan setelah intervensi (p<0,01). Hasil uji Kruskal-Wallis mengonfirmasi adanya perbedaan efektivitas yang signifikan di antara ketiga media sosial tersebut (χ^2=11,005; df=2; p=0,004). Kelompok TikTok memperoleh nilai mean rank tertinggi sebesar 73,84, diikuti oleh kelompok WhatsApp sebesar 55,80, dan kelompok Instagram sebesar 50,71. Dengan demikian, media sosial berbasis video pendek seperti TikTok merupakan media edukasi yang paling unggul dan direkomendasikan sebagai sarana utama dalam intervensi promosi kesehatan pencegahan anemia pada remaja putri.

abstractText: Penjual kelapa parut dan santan di Kota Palangka Raya kerap membuang ampas kelapa atau menjualnya sebagai pakan ternak dengan harga rendah. Pada saat yang sama, pencatatan keuangan usaha mereka belum tertata. Program pengabdian ini mengupayakan peningkatan nilai ampas kelapa sekaligus penguatan pengelolaan usaha melalui pembuatan camilan Re-Flake Copu-Copu dan pendampingan akuntansi UMKM. Pelatihan utama dilaksanakan pada 28 Agustus 2026 dengan melibatkan 16 pedagang kelapa parut dan santan yang dipilih secara purposif berdasarkan kesesuaian karakteristik usaha, yaitu menghasilkan ampas kelapa dalam kegiatan usahanya sehari-hari dan bersedia mengikuti program. SPIRIT-CONSORT-ELM: element-level annotated dataset and large language model approach for assessing randomized controlled trial reporting
abstractText: Abstract Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) are central to assessing the benefits and harms of interventions, but incomplete reporting undermines their verifiability and usefulness. Although SPIRIT and CONSORT reporting guidelines promote complete reporting of RCT protocols and results publications, many RCTs remain incompletely reported. Automated manuscript checking could help improve reporting completeness before publication. We previously developed SPIRIT-CONSORT-TM, a corpus of 200 articles (100 protocol-results publication pairs) annotated with 83 checklist items from SPIRIT 2013 and CONSORT 2010, and trained models for item-level assessment. However, checklist items may comprise multiple constituent elements, which prior work did not capture or evaluate. Here, we extend the corpus with element-level annotations (SPIRIT-CONSORT-ELM) and formulate assessment as a machine reading comprehension task operationalized through 119 questions targeting specific reporting elements. Two annotators independently assessed 50 articles (25 pairs), with discrepancies resolved through discussion; one annotator assessed the remaining 150 articles. We then developed an automated pipeline combining PubMedBERT-based evidence retrieval with GPT-5-based question answering. Inter-annotator agreement was high (Gwet’s AC1: 0.782), and the pipeline achieved high performance (F1: 0.822, Gwet’s AC1: 0.796). Component analyses demonstrated the importance of evidence retrieval quality and modest benefits from illustrative in-context examples. SPIRIT-CONSORT-ELM provides a benchmark for fine-grained assessment of RCT reporting completeness, while the automated pipeline establishes a robust baseline and shows potential for supporting authors, reviewers, and editors.

abstractText: Abstract Microglia-regulated neuroinflammation is associated with major depressive disorder (MDD), yet the molecular drivers of pathological microglia-neuron interactions remain poorly defined. Here, we conducted single-nucleus RNA sequencing (snRNA-seq) of the prefrontal cortex (PFC) in mice susceptible to chronic social defeat stress (CSDS) and identified a distinct microglial transcriptional signature that is enriched for phagocytic and immune activation pathways. Gene module analysis revealed a coordinated dysregulation linking microglia-specific programs to excitatory neuronal dysfunction. Morphological and ultrastructural analyses revealed enhanced microglial synaptic engulfment accompanied by synaptic alterations in the medial PFC of susceptible mice. By comparing data from MDD patients, a non-human primate model of depression, and a depression mouse model, we identified microglial Arhgap22 (Rho GTPase Activating Protein 22) downregulation as a conserved alteration in depression models across species. Arhgap22 overexpression in microglia attenuated CSDS-associated synaptic phagocytosis and synaptic damage, while partially ameliorating depression-related behavioral phenotypes. Collectively, these findings provide microglia-centered, cross-cell-type, and cross-species insights and identify Arhgap22 as a conserved microglial modulator of synaptic phagocytosis and depression-related behavioral phenotypes.

abstractText: Purpose: Diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease (AD) and Parkinson's disease (PD) remains challenging, and existing AI-based neuroimaging tools are typically applied in isolation for diagnosis, multimodal analysis, or progression tracking. This study aims to develop an integrated, three-stage deep learning framework that unifies these tasks into a single diagnostic and prognostic pipeline. Design/Methodology/Approach: The framework was developed and validated using the OASIS, ADNI, PPMI, and TCIA databases and comprises three sequential stages. The first stage, MHNFSP, applies fuzzy c-means segmentation to MRI/fMRI scans, followed by extraction of Fourier transform, entropy, and convolutional features; the Whale Optimisation Algorithm is then used for feature selection, and a hybrid neural-statistical classifier performs final prediction. The second stage conducts multimodal assessment by fusing MRI, CT, and X-ray data through a multi-head self-attention mechanism, using UNet++ for region-of-interest segmentation and Grad-CAM++ for visual explainability. The third stage, LMST-ADNet, focuses on longitudinal disease modelling by combining MRI, PET, and fMRI connectivity data with clinical-genetic information, employing modality-specific encoders, temporal modelling, and self-supervised pre-training. Research Limitation: The study relies on retrospective, publicly available datasets that may not fully capture the demographic and clinical diversity of real-world patient populations. External, prospective, multi-site validation and testing on unseen clinical cohorts would be required to confirm generalisability before clinical deployment. Findings: The MHNFSP stage achieved 96.39% classification accuracy on MRI/fMRI data. The multimodal fusion stage achieved 95.3% accuracy, a mean Dice score of 0.92 and an Intersection over Union (IoU) of 88.0% agreement with expert-marked regions. The LMST-ADNet stage achieved 96.8% classification accuracy, an AUC of 0.982, and a C-index of 0.91 for progression risk prediction. Ablation studies confirmed that temporal modelling substantially contributes to performance, with additional gains obtained through self-supervised pre-training. Practical Implication: The proposed three-stage system offers clinicians and radiologists an integrated tool capable of supporting early diagnosis, multimodal cross-verification, and long-term monitoring of neurodegenerative disease progression, potentially reducing diagnostic delay and supporting more personalised treatment planning. Social Implication: Earlier and more reliable detection of AD and PD could improve patient quality of life, reduce caregiver burden, and lower long-term healthcare costs associated with delayed diagnosis and disease management, particularly benefiting ageing populations at higher risk. Originality/Value: Unlike prior approaches that address diagnosis, multimodal fusion, and progression prediction as separate problems, this study proposes a unified three-stage architecture that integrates segmentation-based classification, explainable multimodal fusion, and longitudinal transformer-based progression modelling within a single coherent framework, offering a more holistic assessment pathway for neurodegenerative disease research.

abstractText: Abstract The Dubia cockroach Blaptica dubia is a promising protein source for animal feed, but information on stage-specific feeding preferences remains limited. This study evaluated the feeding preference of B. dubia males, females and nymphs for six ingredients (cottonseed meal, soybean meal, corn, wheat bran, rice bran and sorghum) and the proximate composition of insects and faeces. In a completely randomised design, three life stages were evaluated (four replicates/treatment). Insect dry matter (DM) differed significantly among stages ( ; females 53.30%, males 45.12%, nymphs 31.21%), while crude protein (63.43%), ether extract (39.87%) and mineral matter (4.42%) were similar ( ). Faeces weight ( ; females 0.81 g, males 0.68 g, nymphs 0.16 g) and composition ( ) varied across stages. Total dry matter intake (DMI) did not differ ( ), but Relative Intake Rate ( ) peaked in nymphs and adult males. Descriptive stage-specific patterns showed nymphs favoured wheat bran and sorghum; females preferred rice bran and wheat bran; and adult males preferred sorghum and corn. Overall, sorghum (33.08%) and rice bran (25.68%) accounted for the largest proportional shares of total intake across all stages ( ), followed by wheat bran (15.09%) and soybean meal (14.15%), while corn (6.01%) and cottonseed meal (5.99%) were the least consumed. These results provide insights into B. dubia dietary preferences, enabling precision-feeding strategies and diet optimisation for sustainable commercial mass-rearing systems.

title: VIVÊNCIAS DE DISCENTES DA LICENCIATURA EM EDUCAÇÃO FÍSICA ACERCA DOS PRIMEIROS SOCORROS
abstractText: Os primeiros socorros são ações efetuadas imediatamente após a ocorrência de um acidente ou mal súbito, para evitar o agravamento até a chegada do atendimento de saúde especializado. As escolas são locais propícios às situações de acidentes, com destaque para práticas esportivas e recreativas, ambiente em que se configura local de trabalho do profissional de Educação Física, que neste sentido deve estar qualificado a prestar assistência adequada. Sendo assim, este estudo teve como objetivo apresentar as vivências de discentes de períodos iniciais do curso de Licenciatura em Educação Física da Universidade Federal do Piauí (UFPI) acerca da prestação dos primeiros socorros, ainda como leigos no assunto. Esta pesquisa foi realizada com 55 discentes do curso de Educação Física e os dados foram obtidos por meio de um relato sobre suas experiências e vivências, relacionados a situação necessária a prestação de primeiros socorros. Constatou-se que 44% dos discentes, aturaram como observadores, em que os locais anatômicos mais acometidos foram os membros inferiores, locais dos acidentes em que mais frequentemente ocorreram, em casa 40% e com sentimento de desespero 40%, diante das situações mencionadas. Conclui-se que maioria dos discentes não se sentem preparados e confiantes para aplicar os procedimentos de primeiros socorros, evidenciando a importância da disciplina de primeiros socorros durante a graduação.

title: Behavioural insights into stigma-free relational support for pregnant smokers
abstractText: Purpose This study aims to present behavioural insights from a pilot stigma-free, incentive-supported pregnancy smoking cessation intervention implemented within one of the NHS trusts in Nottinghamshire, England, UK. Design/methodology/approach Quantitative data included operational service metrics (e.g. quit-date setting pre-, during and post-incentive), socio-demographic context and infant health indicators. Qualitative data included semi-structured interviews with pregnant people who achieved smoke-free births, in-depth reflections from tobacco dependency practitioners and academic reflexive accounts. Data were analysed using descriptive statistical comparison for quantitative data and thematic analysis for qualitative data. Findings The incentives increased the quit date setting at a service level. Infant health indicators among quitters resembled those of non-smokers and differed from those who continued smoking. Interviews reveal that stigma, including internalised, anticipated and enacted stigma, became a significant behavioural barrier to engagement. Non-judgemental, relational support from practitioners was vital in overcoming these stigma types, enhancing agency and sustaining cessation. While incentives supported engagement with the service and maintenance of smoking cessation, concern for the baby’s health and trusting relationships were the primary drivers of motivation. Practical implications Smoking cessation interventions in pregnancy should move beyond instrumental approaches. Financial incentives are most effective when embedded within stigma-free, relationship-centred service models. Social marketing interventions should prioritise non-judgemental communication, practitioner training to minimise stigma and to cope with emotional labour and system-level alignment to support sustained behaviour change. Originality/value This study advances social marketing scholarship by integrating behavioural, emotional and relational insights in interventions. It demonstrates how stigma reduction and relational value creation mediate the effectiveness of behavioural incentives, offering empirically grounded guidance for designing socially responsive interventions.

title: Three-dimensional seismic analysis based on FE modeling using 3-D survey incorporating spatial variability of stiffness
abstractText: Abstract Japan is one of the most earthquake-prone countries in the world, where a significant portion of disaster-related losses can be attributed to structural collapses. Thus, the inspection of geo-structures related to these earthquakes is important. Although conventional inspections are conducted by two-dimensional analyses, the actual behaviors of the structures are affected three-dimensionally. This has led to an increase in the demand for three-dimensional analyses. A three-dimensional survey has recently been developed, using an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV), which has made the rebuilding of the three-dimensional shape of structures easier. Despite the development of this technique, it has not been adopted for the design of geo-structures. In this study, for the purpose of incorporating the three-dimensional survey technique into the design of geo-structures, an earth-fill dam is surveyed three-dimensionally by a drone, and a three-dimensional finite element model (FEM model) of the dam is made based on the survey results and the newly developed modeling approach. The spatial distribution of the ground stiffness is estimated based on screw weight sounding (SWS) test results, and then applied to the 3-D FEM modeling. Gaussian process regression (GPR), which serves as a geostatistical interpolation framework to transform sparse field measurements into continuous three-dimensional material property distributions for the FEM model, is employed for the spatial interpolation of the ground stiffness. Finally, the FEM model is applied to a seismic response analysis, and the locations of high acceleration and high shear stress inside the earth-fill dam are identified.

Nutrition and health status in the follow-up of the risks and benefits of a vegan diet (RBVD) study
abstractText: Abstract To examine health risks and benefits of a vegan diet, the RBVD study was conducted in 2017 and followed up in 2021. The present paper evaluated dietary nutrient intake and status together with systemic cardiometabolic health-related biomarkers and examinations among vegans and omnivores in 2017 and 2021. Our study included n = 24 vegans and n = 26 omnivores (aged 30–60 years at baseline), who participated at both time points. Dietary nutrient intake was determined by 3-day weighed food records and an interview about supplement use. Nutrient status and health-related biomarkers were measured in blood and 24-h urine samples. Despite similar energy intake, fibre intake was higher and saturated fat intake was lower in vegans compared to omnivores at both time points. Vitamin B 12 status did not differ between both groups at any time. Compared to omnivores, vegans had higher blood concentrations of folate and 25-hydroxyvitamin D in 2021, and lower vitamin A and B 2 concentrations in 2017. Blood concentrations of magnesium and copper were similar in both groups at both time points, while urinary calcium excretion was lower in vegans compared to omnivores in 2021. Selenium and zinc serum concentrations were consistently lower in vegans. Compared to omnivores, vegans had lower serum total and LDL cholesterol as well as plasma HbA1c at both time points. Over a four-year period, significant nutritional intake, status and health biomarker differences were observed between vegans and omnivores. Future research is needed to clarify the associated long-term health risks and benefits.

title: Experimental Evaluation of a Nav2 Regulated Pure Pursuit-PID Architecture for Trajectory Tracking of a Four-Wheel Mecanum Mobile Robot
abstractText: This paper reports an experimental evaluation of a Nav2 Regulated Pure Pursuit (RPP)-PID architecture for trajectory tracking of a four-wheel Mecanum mobile robot. The high-level RPP controller runs on an NVIDIA Jetson Nano at 50 Hz, while four proportional-integral-derivative (PID) loops on an STM32 microcontroller regulate individual wheel speeds at 100 Hz. PP and RPP were evaluated using the same robot hardware, map, PID gains, start pose, goal pose, and reference path. Each quantitative tracking condition was repeated five times. RPP reduced the mean RMSE from 0.12 ± 0.03 m to 0.08 ± 0.01 m for curved-path tracking and from 0.10 ± 0.02 m to 0.05 ± 0.02 m for goal reaching. Obstacle-avoidance experiments were also conducted with both controllers under matched conditions and are discussed as system-level navigation tests because planning, localization, perception, and control remained active. The controller uses nominal Mecanum kinematics without explicit slip or delay compensation. The results demonstrate improved geometric tracking accuracy for RPP under the tested indoor conditions and confirm stable online operation of the distributed RPP-PID architecture.

abstractText: Background: Ocular involvement in myelodysplastic syndrome (MDS)-associated Sweet syndrome is uncommon. Bilateral nodular scleritis with severe fibrinous anterior uveitis presents diagnostic and treatment challenges in an immunocompromised patient. Objective: To describe the presentation and 30-day response to treatment in an adolescent with MDS-associated ocular Sweet syndrome. Methods: This longitudinal case report documented visual acuity, slit-lamp findings, B-scan ultrasonography, laboratory results, and infection surveillance at baseline and on days 7, 14, and 30. Results: A 16-year-old boy with MDS, marasmus, and prior tuberculosis developed bilateral nodular scleritis and severe right-eye fibrinous anterior uveitis. Baseline visual acuity was 1/300 in the right eye and 6/30 in the left. Following multidisciplinary assessment, he received oral methylprednisolone (0.8 mg/kg/day), topical dexamethasone, and prophylactic levofloxacin. By day 14, the pupillary membrane had cleared and scleral nodules had regressed. At day 30, visual acuity was 6/60 and 6/18, respectively, without observed tuberculosis reactivation or hepatotoxicity. Conclusion: Coordinated corticosteroid treatment with close infectious and systemic surveillance was associated with sustained ocular improvement in this high-risk patient. Discussion: The marked interocular asymmetry and sterile inflammatory findings emphasize the need to exclude infection before immunosuppression and to monitor systemic risks throughout treatment.

abstractText: Shivering is a common complication in patients undergoing spinal anesthesia. Spinal anesthesia causes sympathetic block and vasodilation, leading to a redistribution of body heat and a lowered shivering threshold. Shivering can increase oxygen consumption and carbon dioxide production, as well as cause discomfort in patients. This study aimed to determine the incidence of shivering in surgical patients undergoing spinal anesthesia at Makassar Central General Hospital. This study employed a descriptive design with a cross-sectional approach. The sample consisted of 30 respondents selected using total sampling from February 2 to March 4, 2026, at the Central Surgical Unit. The degree of shivering was directly observed using the Mahajan Scale observation sheet (0–4), while data on age, gender, and duration of surgery were obtained from medical records. Data were analyzed univariately in the form of frequency distributions and percentages. The results showed that the majority of respondents experienced grade 2 shivering defined as muscle activity limited to a single muscle group with 17 respondents (56.7%), while 13 respondents (43.3%) experienced grade 1 shivering, and no cases of severe shivering were found. Most respondents were aged 25–59 years (63.3%), were female (80.0%), and underwent surgery lasting more than 1 hour (86.7%). In conclusion, the incidence of shivering in surgical patients under spinal anesthesia is predominantly moderate in severity, thus requiring monitoring and preventive measures, such as the use of warming blankets and warmed intravenous fluids.

title: Comparative Study of Garuda (Khrut) Mythical Creature Visual Representation in Indonesian and Thai Architecture
abstractText: Indonesia and Thailand share a common mythical heritage, Garuda (Khrut), which serves both as a spiritual figure and a symbol of national identity. However, significant differences exist in the stylistic approaches, symbolic narratives, and functional placements of Garuda imagery, shaped by each nation's unique historical, religious, and socio-cultural contexts. This study explores how the visual language of Garuda in architecture contributes to contemporary expressions of national identity and environmental design in public spaces. The objectives of this research are: (1) to identify how mythological symbolism is applied in prominent public architecture in Indonesia and Thailand; (2) to examine the socio-cultural and historical influences that shape the stylistic variations of Garuda representations; and (3) to analyze the visual interpretation of Garuda imagery within architectural contexts in present-day Indonesia and Thailand. This study employs a comparative visual analysis method, investigating how Garuda is interpreted and integrated into architectural elements in both countries. Implementing comparative analysis, this study integrates a semiotic perspective using Charles Sanders Peirce’s triadic model (signifier, signified, and referent) to deepen the interpretation of Garuda’s imagery within architectural contexts. Findings reveal a shared Southeast Asian architectural tradition in which Garuda or Khrut serves as a vehicle of cultural continuity, collective memory, and ideological reproduction. The study concludes that Garuda functions as an active architectural discourse mediating tradition, modernity, myth, governance, heritage, and identity. Through comparative and semiotic analysis, this research demonstrates the consistency of mythological symbolism in shaping public Southeast Asian architecture.

title: Antibody-mediated immune surveillance as an organizing axis of gut microbiota structure
abstractText: Abstract Background The symbiotic interplay between the immune system and the endogenous microbiome is essential for maintaining homeostasis. However, most microbiome research focuses primarily on associations between disease and microbial composition, often overlooking host–microbiota interactions as a defining component of health and pathology. The gut microbiota is continuously monitored by the immune system, particularly via immunoglobulin A (IgA), which shapes microbial communities by selectively targeting specific taxa. Despite its central role, IgA-mediated immune surveillance has rarely been formalized as a quantitative axis in microbiota analysis, limiting our understanding of how host–microbe interactions influence health and disease. Results We developed an immune-informed framework to quantify IgA-mediated microbial engagement using the Species Immune Engagement Score (IM score ). IM score integrates three key features: IgA binding to each microbe, microbial abundance, and prevalence across individuals, producing a quantitative measure of how actively the immune system targets each taxon. Applying IM score across three geographically distinct cohorts, we identified a conserved set of IgA-targeted gut microbes. This includes well-characterized commensals, such as Coprococcus comes and uncharacterized taxa (e.g . , Oscillospiraceae SGB15216), highlighting microbes that are immunologically relevant but often overlooked. In early multiple sclerosis (MS), IM score revealed a profound fragmentation of IgA-mediated immune engagement, particularly among short-chain fatty acid–producing bacteria and dominant archaeal lineage. These patterns are not captured by standard diversity or compositional metrics. To capture community-level organization, we aggregated IM score values into the Immunologically Engaged Gut Microbiota Index (IMG index ). Using IMG index , we tracked disruptions in IgA-mediated immune engagement in early MS and observed its sensitivity to changes following fecal microbiota transplantation and fluctuations in disease activity. This demonstrates the potential of IMG index to monitor both disease-associated alterations and therapeutic responses. Conclusion These findings establish IgA-mediated immune surveillance as a quantifiable axis of gut microbiota organization, providing an ecological framework for understanding host–microbe interactions.

title: Communicative agency as a dimension of sustainability competence: evidence from an international higher education microcredential
abstractText: Purpose Despite extensive research on sustainability education, a persistent challenge remains in understanding how students translate sustainability awareness into communicatively and socially actionable forms. While existing frameworks emphasise cognitive, affective and behavioural dimensions of sustainability competence, the role of communication in enabling action remains under-theorised. This study aims to address this gap by conceptualising communicative agency as a complementary and exploratory dimension of sustainability competence. Design/methodology/approach Adopting a qualitative exploratory case study design, the research combines diagnostic survey data with discourse analysis of student-produced artefacts within an international microcredential course on English Communication for Sustainable Development. The analysis focuses on how students construct sustainability discourse across key dimensions, including actor representation, attribution of responsibility, modalisation and audience positioning. Findings Findings show that students initially demonstrate strong normative awareness of the importance of communication but limited confidence in its practical application. Through project-based learning, students move from awareness towards the enactment of communicative agency, constructing sustainability as actionable by identifying agents, framing responsibility, calibrating urgency and feasibility and designing audience-oriented interventions. Communication emerges not only as the transmission of information, but as a discursive resource through which students begin to structure responsibility, agency and possible action. Social implications By foregrounding communication as a mechanism through which sustainability knowledge is translated into socially actionable forms, the study highlights the importance of preparing students to engage with sustainability challenges across diverse public, professional and institutional contexts. Communication-centred pedagogies may support more participatory and context-sensitive forms of sustainability engagement by enabling learners to identify relevant actors, negotiate responsibility and design audience-oriented interventions. Originality/value The study introduces communicative agency as a previously under-theorised dimension of sustainability competence, conceptualised as the discourse-mediated capacity to translate knowledge into socially actionable forms. By integrating sustainability education, discourse theory and communicative competence frameworks, the paper provides both a theoretical contribution – reframing a dimension of the knowledge–action gap as communicative in nature – and an empirical model for analysing how sustainability learning becomes operational in practice.

title: Quantification of Contaminants and Proton Exchange in Garnet Phase Powders and Their Impact on Li+ Transport in Hybrid Electrolytes
abstractText: Abstract Garnet-phase Li7La3Zr2O12 (LLZO) is a promising solid-state electrolyte in lithium metal batteries but suffers from contaminant formation upon exposure to ambient conditions. We use a suite of analytical methods to quantify this contamination and the resulting protonation of Ta-doped LLZO’s (LLZTO) crystal structure and their removal via heat treatment under argon. We quantify contaminant removal in 3 unique temperature regimes: one where LiOH is removed at lower temperatures (<350 °C) and two where Li2CO3 is removed at intermediate (350–550 °C) and high (>550 °C) temperatures. Removal of LiOH and Li2CO3 in the intermediate regime proceeds through a mechanism involving beneficial H+/Li+ exchange with the LLZTO lattice, whereas high-temperature Li2CO3 removal proceeds through the thermal decomposition mechanism of Li2CO3 to evolve CO2 and deposit solid Li2O. Through these quantification methods, we show that most, but not all, contaminants are removed upon heating to 800 °C, with 97% of Li2CO3 and 85% of LiOH present in the as-given materials being removed. We show that heat treatment in a stagnant atmosphere is less effective than treatment under active gas flow. Re-lithiation of the LLZTO lattice is also found to improve Li+ transport across the LLZTO particle interface when immersed in a Li+-bearing organic electrolyte, and the protonation of LLZTO contributes more to slowing interfacial Li+ transport than the presence of interfacial contaminants.

title: Preconception maternal infection-related exposures and risk of congenital heart disease in offspring: evidence from a large population-based cohort in South China
abstractText: Abstract Background Maternal infections during pregnancy have been associated with congenital heart disease (CHD) in offspring. However, the associations of preconception maternal infection-related exposures with offspring CHD risk remain unclear. This study aimed to evaluate the independent and joint associations of reproductive tract infections and pathogen-specific immunoglobulin G (IgG) seropositivity assessed at the preconception examination with offspring CHD. Methods We conducted a population-based cohort study of 630,968 women planning pregnancy in Guangdong, China (2014–2018). Preconception maternal infection-related exposures comprised reproductive tract infections (candidiasis and Chlamydia trachomatis infection) and immunoglobulin G (IgG) seropositivity to cytomegalovirus, Toxoplasma gondii , and rubella virus. The primary outcome was offspring CHD recorded in the birth defects registry. Adjusted relative risks (RRs) and risk differences (RDs) per 1,000 births, with corresponding 95% confidence intervals (CIs), were estimated using multivariable modified Poisson regression with robust error variance. Results Among 630,968 pregnancies, 1,312 infants (0.21%) were diagnosed with CHD. In the expanded multivariable models, Chlamydia trachomatis infection was associated with increased offspring CHD risk (adjusted RR, 1.89; 95% CI, 1.14–3.15), as was cytomegalovirus (CMV) IgG seropositivity (adjusted RR, 2.70; 95% CI, 2.26–3.22). Associations were also observed for candidiasis (adjusted RR, 1.50; 95% CI, 1.12–2.02), rubella IgG seropositivity (adjusted RR, 1.59; 95% CI, 1.37–1.83), and Toxoplasma gondii IgG seropositivity (adjusted RR, 1.32; 95% CI, 1.01–1.74). Jointly exposed groups also had elevated risk, including Chlamydia trachomatis infection with CMV IgG seropositivity (adjusted RR, 5.14; 95% CI, 2.92–9.06) and candidiasis with CMV IgG seropositivity (adjusted RR, 3.72; 95% CI, 2.53–5.49). Results were consistent in sensitivity analyses. Conclusions In this large population-based cohort study, preconception maternal infection-related exposures, comprising reproductive tract infections and pathogen-specific IgG seropositivity, were associated with increased offspring congenital heart disease risk. Elevated estimates in jointly exposed groups describe joint exposure patterns and should not be interpreted as evidence of biological interaction.

title: Assessing the Mining Effluent Impacts on Mercury Dynamics in Boreal Lakes
abstractText: Abstract Mining wastewater and leakages into freshwater systems are a growing global concern, yet the impacts of bioleaching in open-pit mining on lake food webs and mercury dynamics remain understudied. This study examined three boreal lakes in eastern Finland: Jormasjärvi (primarily previously mining-impacted), Nuasjärvi (currently impacted), and Kiantajärvi (control). Food-web structure was analysed using stable carbon and nitrogen isotopes, while total mercury (THg) bioaccumulation in fish and biomagnification across the food web were examined using linear regressions. Jormasjärvi showed a simplified and less diverse pelagic food web. Top predators relied more on littoral resources, and key pelagic species, such as the acid-sensitive Mysis relicta , had disappeared from Jormasjärvi after mining impact. THg content in top predators were highest in Jormasjärvi where 20% of the analysed fillets exceeded mercury safety limits. On average, Jormasjärvi perch ( Perca fluviatilis ) over 27 cm, pikeperch ( Sander lucioperca ) over 40 cm and pike ( Esox lucius ) over 78 cm surpassed these thresholds (pike: 1.0 mg/kg; others: 0.5 mg/kg). Despite elevated THg levels, the trophic magnification slope and THg baseline in Jormasjärvi did not differ significantly from the control lake. In contrast, THg magnified fastest in Nuasjärvi where lowest THg baseline was observed, likely reflecting differences in water chemistry influencing Hg uptake. Overall, the findings suggest that bioleaching-related mining can increase Hg concentrations in top predators by altering food-web structure and energy pathways. However, Hg dynamics are highly context-dependent. The study highlights the importance of collecting baseline food-web data before mining begins to enable accurate before-and-after comparisons and better assess environmental impacts.

title: Considerable Anisotropy Magnetoresistance by Oxygen-Mediated Spin State Manipulation in a Highly Textured Multilayer for Ultrasensitive Sensor Application
abstractText: Abstract Spin state manipulation in anisotropy magnetoresistance (AMR) materials is key to improving their transport property for constructing highly sensitive and direction-resolvable magnetic sensors. Currently, the mainstream strategy of tuning the transport property focuses on the modulation of charge by controlling the physical scattering path of conduction electrons, limiting the AMR ratio below 4% and linear sensitivity lower than 1.5%/Oe. This paper reports a strategy of manipulating the orbital degree of freedom to achieve an unprecedently large AMR effect. Here, we achieved the oxygen tunability of the spin state in a highly textured MgO/NiFe/MgO/Ta multilayer by regulating the Fe–O orbital hybridization in the lattice-texture-tunable coordination environment. The (111)- and (110)-textured films exhibit a low-spin state, offering enough unoccupied d↑ states to enhance the s–d↑ scattering and improve the transport property. On this basis, a considerable AMR ratio of 8.7% and a high linear sensitivity of 2.7%/Oe were achieved, helping to construct an ultrasensitive sensor with sensitivity approaching 3.3 mV/V/Oe, which is the highest value among the commercialized AMR sensors. These results provide a feasible idea for developing the orbital-modulated AMR sensor and clarify the physical origin of magneto-ion-spin coupling.

abstractText: Digital transformation in education requires schools to manage digital learning resources effectively in order to support student learning and assessment. However, its implementation still faces various challenges relating to technological readiness, organizational capacity, and environmental support. This study aims to analyze the management of digital learning resources in supporting student learning and assessment, to identify the factors influencing its implementation based on the Technology, Organization, and Environment (TOE) framework, and to formulate strategies that support effective and sustainable digital transformation in education. The research employed a qualitative approach with a multi-site study design at SMP Negeri 2 Bandar Lampung and SMP Negeri 22 Bandar Lampung. Data were collected through in-depth interviews, observations, and document analysis, and were subsequently analyzed using an interactive model comprising data condensation, data presentation, and the drawing of conclusions, with validity checks carried out through triangulation of sources, techniques, and member checking. The research findings indicate that the management of digital learning resources has been systematically implemented through planning, organization, implementation, and evaluation that support student learning and assessment. The success of implementation is influenced by the synergy between the technological, organizational, and environmental dimensions, whilst strategies to strengthen digital leadership, enhance teacher competence, strategic planning, and collaboration with stakeholders are key factors in supporting sustainable digital transformation. This research contributes by integrating the TOE framework into the analysis of digital learning resource management, thereby enriching the study of educational management and offering an implementation model that schools can adapt to develop digital transformation. ABSTRAK Transformasi digital dalam pendidikan menuntut sekolah untuk mengelola sumber belajar digital secara efektif guna mendukung pembelajaran dan penilaian siswa. Namun, implementasinya masih menghadapi berbagai tantangan yang berkaitan dengan kesiapan teknologi, kapasitas organisasi, dan dukungan lingkungan. Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis manajemen sumber belajar digital dalam mendukung pembelajaran dan penilaian siswa, mengidentifikasi faktor-faktor yang memengaruhi implementasinya berdasarkan kerangka kerja Technology, Organization, and Environment (TOE), serta merumuskan strategi yang mendukung transformasi digital pendidikan secara efektif dan berkelanjutan. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif dengan desain studi multisitus pada SMP Negeri 2 Bandar Lampung dan SMP Negeri 22 Bandar Lampung. Data diperoleh melalui wawancara mendalam, observasi, dan studi dokumentasi, kemudian dianalisis menggunakan model interaktif yang meliputi kondensasi data, penyajian data, dan penarikan kesimpulan dengan uji keabsahan melalui triangulasi sumber, triangulasi teknik, dan member checking. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa manajemen sumber belajar digital telah diimplementasikan secara sistematis melalui perencanaan, pengorganisasian, pelaksanaan, dan evaluasi yang mendukung pembelajaran dan penilaian siswa. Keberhasilan implementasi dipengaruhi oleh sinergi antara dimensi teknologi, organisasi, dan lingkungan, sedangkan strategi penguatan kepemimpinan digital, peningkatan kompetensi guru, perencanaan strategis, dan kolaborasi dengan pemangku kepentingan menjadi faktor penting dalam mendukung transformasi digital yang berkelanjutan. Penelitian ini memberikan kontribusi dengan mengintegrasikan kerangka kerja TOE dalam analisis manajemen sumber belajar digital sehingga memperkaya kajian manajemen pendidikan dan menawarkan model implementasi yang dapat diadaptasi oleh sekolah dalam mengembangkan transformasi digital.

title: Vibrio repeats (VXRs) play a role in horizontal dissemination of sedentary chromosomal integron-associated antibiotic resistance genes across Vibrio species
abstractText: Abstract Sedentary chromosomal integrons (SCIs) are large integrons that harbor extensive arrays of gene cassettes and constitute major reservoirs of bacterial genetic diversity. In Vibrio , SCI cassettes are flanked by species-associated attC repeats, here referred to as Vibrio species repeats (VXRs). Although SCIs have been proposed as ancestral sources of antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs), the extent to which SCI-associated ARGs are exchanged among Vibrio species remains poorly understood. To investigate the dynamics of SCI-associated ARGs, we analyzed 37,812 genomes representing 181 Vibrio species. Using VXR mapping, comparative phylogenetics, and genome screening, we identified 8,679 putative ARG cassettes distributed across 8,517 genomes from 11 species. Despite the diversity of VXRs identified in SCIs, ARG cassettes were predominantly associated with a small subset of related VXRs shared among phylogenetically distant species, suggesting horizontal transfer of ARG-associated cassettes across the genus. Comparative analyses further suggested that members of the Cholera clade may act as potential sources of SCI-associated ARG dissemination. Five major ARG families were identified within SCIs, including cat B, qnr VC, bla CARB , dfr A, and vat F, some of which displayed phylogenetic patterns consistent with interspecies transfer. Functional characterization of a SCI-associated qnr VC4 cassette from Vibrio mimicus confirmed its ability to confer reduced susceptibility to ciprofloxacin in a heterologous host. Together, our findings indicate that a conserved subset of VXR backbones, mainly from the Cholera clade, plays a role in ARG dissemination across Vibrio species, highlighting SCIs as active reservoirs contributing to the emergence and spread of antimicrobial resistance.

Fabrication and Lithium Storage Performance of Trigonal W2N Thin-Film Anode
abstractText: Abstract The preparation, characterization of materials, and electrochemical performance of trigonal W2N thin film as the anode material for lithium-ion batteries have been reported. The trigonal W2N thin film with the space group of P3̅ was synthesized by the sputtering deposition followed by a nitridation treatment. The first-principles calculations reveal that the adsorption energy of Li+ on the (001) crystal plane of trigonal W2N is −1.55 eV and the Li+ diffusion energy barrier is only 0.23 eV, indicating a significant kinetic superiority for rapid Li+ transport. The results of electrochemical tests demonstrate that the trigonal W2N thin-film electrode maintains a stable specific capacity of 700 mA h g–1 at the current density of 0.1 A g–1 after 100 cycles. Even at the current density of 1 A g–1, the specific capacity is initially decreased but subsequently rebounded, finally retaining that at 680 mA h g–1 after 300 cycles. The results of cyclic voltammetry and ex situ XPS analyses confirm that the lithium storage mechanism involves Li+ intercalation/deintercalation and a reversible conversion reaction. Owing to its high specific capacity, good cycling stability, and superior rate performance, the trigonal W2N thin-film electrode offers a promising research direction for high-performance anode materials of thin-film lithium-ion batteries in the future.

Reversible Inhibition of Ammonia Monooxygenase by 1,9-Decanediol Triggers a RegB-RegA-Associated Energy Crisis and Stress Response in Nitrosomonas europaea
abstractText: Abstract 1,9-decanediol, a rice-derived biological nitrification inhibitor (BNI) suppresses soil nitrification and nitrous-oxide emissions, but the mechanisms of action against ammonia-oxidizing bacteria remain unclear. Combining physiology and transcriptomics in Nitrosomonas europaea, we show that a dose-dependent and reversible inhibition of ammonia oxidation by 1,9-decanediol by up to 44.7%, while maintaining high cell viability. Transcriptomics reveal that inhibition of ammonia monooxygenase (AMO) triggered an energy crisis, downregulating the respiratory complexes (nuo, coxA/B, atp). We propose that the RegB-RegA two-component system senses the redox imbalance and contributes to a biosynthesis-to-defense transition, marked by an 8.9-fold induction of amoC3 and suppression of ribosomal and amino-acid synthesis. Activation of RND-efflux pumps and chemotaxis enable active counteraction and escape from the stressor. This study provides crude-enzyme-based evidence for AMO as a primary target of a reversible BNI and integrates it with genome-wide transcriptomics, offering molecular insight into designing nature-based nitrification inhibitors and BNI-enhanced crops.

title: Finch–Skea compact stellar configurations in Rastall gravity: structure, stability, and physical admissibility
abstractText: Abstract We construct static, anisotropic compact-star configurations in Rastall gravity using the Finch–Skea metric ansatz and investigate how the Rastall coupling modifies the structure and stability of ultra-dense matter. We systematically analyze the dependence of the energy density, pressures, anisotropy, compactness, and gravitational redshift on the Rastall parameter, with the general relativity (GR) limit recovered when the coupling vanishes. The resulting mass–radius and moment of inertia–mass relations show that the Rastall modification can increase both the maximum mass and the corresponding moment of inertia relative to the GR configurations. We further compare the predicted maximum mass and moment of inertia with the observational constraints for neutron-star candidates, including PSR J0437–4715, PSR J2222–0137, and PSR J0348+0432, and examine the extent to which the model accommodates the corresponding astrophysically inferred properties. The physical admissibility of the configurations is assessed through the standard energy conditions, causality, the adiabatic-index criterion, the generalized Tolman–Oppenheimer–Volkoff equilibrium equation, and the Herrera cracking condition. Our results indicate that the Rastall coupling provides a systematic modification of the maximum mass, compactness, and rotational properties of anisotropic compact stars while preserving the required physical and stability conditions over the parameter range considered. These results demonstrate that Rastall gravity can provide a viable modified-gravity framework for exploring the structure of ultra-dense compact objects beyond general relativity.

title: Deep phenotyping of white matter tissue composition in dementia with Lewy bodies
abstractText: Abstract Background White matter signal abnormalities (WMSA) on MRI are common in dementia with Lewy bodies (DLB), and more severe WMSA have been associated with increased neurodegeneration in DLB. However, the underlying mechanisms of WMSA remain unclear. Single-Shell 3-Tissue Constrained Spherical Deconvolution (SS3T-CSD) is a diffusion weighted MRI technique that enables detailed characterisation of white matter by estimating three tissue fractions: white matter-like (T W ), grey matter-like (T G ), and cerebrospinal fluid-like (T C ), though to reflect healthy white matter, gliosis, and neurodegeneration. Our aim was to investigate these tissue fractions in WMSA and normal-appearing white matter (NAWM) in the DLB continuum and controls in two independent cohorts, and explore potential differences between patients on the DLB continuum and patients on the Alzheimer’s disease (AD) continuum or with Parkinson’s disease with dementia (PDD). Methods Using two independent cohorts we included 105 individuals along the DLB continuum, 56 along the AD continuum, 14 with PDD, and 125 controls. We assessed group differences in SS3T-CSD measures within NAWM and three WMSA regions extending from the lateral ventricles (juxtaventricular, periventricular, and deep). Results In NAWM, patients on the DLB continuum showed higher T C and a lower T W than controls. Within WMSA, patients on DLB continuum demonstrated lower T G and higher T W and T C in juxtaventricular regions than controls. The findings regarding T W in NAWM and juxtaventricular WMSA and T C in NAWM were replicated in both cohorts. Exploratory comparisons with patients with PDD showed that patients on the DLB continuum had a similar WMSA volume but lower T G in NAWM and periventricular WMSA, and higher T C in juxtaventricular WMSA. There were no statistically significant differences between patients on the DLB and AD continuums in tissue fractions. Conclusion Patients on the DLB continuum have altered tissue compositions in juxtaventricular WMSA and in NAWM compared to controls, which may reflect neurodegeneration instead of processes primarily driven by neuroinflammation or cerebrovascular disease. Our exploratory analysis suggests different findings between patients on the DLB continuum and patients with PDD that should be replicated in an independent cohort. Future endeavours should investigate these findings further by including biomarkers of synucleinopathy and AD-related pathology.
